newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called to open mixed.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called to open mixed.

text.p: COMEX and NYMEX precious metals futures were expected to open mixed Monday, with the surging dollar seen capping any recovery in gold and silver, while platinum group metals continue to gain support from tight supplies.
COMEX December gold, now the active contract, was called unchanged to off $0.50 from Friday's finish of $330.00 an ounce.
In the bullion market, spot gold was quoted at $325.50/70 early, ahead of the London OTC option expiry Tuesday and compared to the London morning fix of $325.40.

COMEX warehouse gold stocks fell 30,873 ounces Friday to 852,323 ounces, while COMEX silver fell 1,188,170 ounces to 172,225,418 ounces, the lowest level seen since the addition of the Wilmington Trust stocks in January.
COMEX September silver was called up 0.5 to 1.0 cent from Friday's close of $4.320.

Platinum-group futures surged on TOCOM again overnight, but NYMEX October platinum was expected to open unchanged to up $1.00 from Friday's close of $416.70 and NYMEX September palladium was called unchanged to down $1.00 from the previous close of $189.65.
